name: CeraVe SA Smoothing Renewing Cream 177ml/6oz
description: Developed with Dermatologists, CeraVe SA Smoothing Cream is a rich, fragrance-free moisturiser for gentle body exfoliation. Enriched with 3 Essential Ceramides, Salicylic Acid & 10% Urea, this fast-absorbing cream gently exfoliates to deliver smoother, softer skin while helping protect the skin's natural barrier. Using CeraVe's MVE Technology, this ingredient packed cream locks in moisture giving continuous hydration for 24 hours. Suitable for Dry, Rough & Bumpy Skin. Also suitable for Keratosis Pilaris and Psoriasis-Prone Skin.
